history.summary: The Sun Temple (Surya Mandir) of Gwalior is a modern temple built in 1988 by industrialist G.D. Birla as a replica of the famous 13th-century Konark Sun Temple of Odisha. It follows the Konark chariot concept: a rath (chariot) drawn by seven horses (symbolising the seven days of the week) with 24 wheels (depicting the hours of the day). The exterior is clad in red sandstone while the interiors use white marble, enclosing an intricate sculpture of Lord Surya. The temple sits in lush gardens; a Naag Devta temple stands nearby (per makemytrip). CSV town and state ('Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh') are correct. Address per listings: Residency Road, Morar, Gwalior - 474004.
